windlessness.englishDescription: The absence of wind or such a state of being windless.

wisely.definitionKo: 마음이 너그럽고 슬기로우며 일의 이치에 밝게.
wisely.englishDescription: In the manner of being benevolent, wise, and sensible.

with a boom.definitionKo: 매우 세차고 꽉 차게 울리는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a boom.englishDescription: A word used to describe a very strong, resonating sound, or such a motion.
with a boom.englishExpression: with a boom; with a bang

with a broad smile.definitionKo: 입만 벌린 채 소리 없이 부드럽게 자꾸 웃는 모양.
with a broad smile.englishDescription: In the manner of smiling softly, quietly, and continuously with one's mouth open.

with a gurgling sound.definitionKo: 적은 양의 액체가 요란하게 계속 끓는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a gurgling sound.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of a small amount of liquid boiling loudly and continuously.
with a gurgling sound.englishExpression: boiling briskly; with a gurgling sound

with a gurgling sound.definitionKo: 많은 양의 액체가 요란하게 계속 끓는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a gurgling sound.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of a large amount of liquid boiling loudly and continuously.
with a gurgling sound.englishExpression: boiling briskly; with a gurgling sound

with a gurgling sound.definitionKo: 액체 등이 매우 높은 온도로 끓는 모양.
with a gurgling sound.englishDescription: In the manner of liquid boiling at a high temperature.

with a radiant smile.definitionKo: 입을 조금 크게 벌리고 소리 없이 밝고 부드럽게 자꾸 웃는 모양.
with a radiant smile.englishDescription: In the manner of smiling quietly, brightly, softly, and continuously with one's mouth slightly open.

with a rumbling sound.definitionKo: 천둥이 치거나 땅이 요란스럽게 울리는 소리.
with a rumbling sound.englishDescription: A word describing the sound of thundering or the land vibrating noisily.
A word describing the sound of a machine, etc., operating noisily.
A word describing the sound of the thunder rumbling loudly.

with a rumbling sound.definitionKo: 아주 가까운 곳에서 천둥이 요란스럽게 치는 소리.
with a rumbling sound.englishDescription: A word describing the sound of the thunder rumbling loudly in a nearby place.

with gasps.definitionKo: 곧 죽을 것처럼 숨이 끊어졌다 이어졌다 하는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with gasps.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the manner of breathing hard as if it is one's last breath.

with gasps.definitionKo: 곧 죽을 것처럼 숨이 끊어졌다 이어졌다 하는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with gasps.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when someone is short of breath as if he/she is about to die soon; in the manner of breathing hard as if it is one's last breath.

with gasps.definitionKo: 곧 죽을 것처럼 숨이 자꾸 끊어졌다 이어졌다 하는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with gasps.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the manner of breathing hard as if it is one's last breath.

with one's mouth open.definitionKo: 말대답을 하거나 무엇을 받아먹을 때 입을 빠르게 벌렸다 닫는 모양.
with one's mouth open.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of opening and then closing  one's mouth quickly when answering back or snapping at something.

with one's mouth open.definitionKo: 말대답을 하거나 무엇을 받아먹을 때 입을 빠르게 벌렸다 닫았다 하는 모양.
with one's mouth open.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of opening and then closing  one's mouth in quick succession when answering back or snapping at something.

with one's mouth open.definitionKo: 대답을 하거나 무엇을 받아먹을 때 입을 빨리 벌렸다가 닫는 모양.
with one's mouth open.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of opening and then closing one's mouth quickly when answering back or snapping at something.

womanly.englishDescription: Having the quality of a woman.

woodpile.definitionKo: 자른 나무를 많이 모아 한 곳에 쌓아 올린 것.
woodpile.englishDescription: A stack of firewood cut and gathered in one spot.

worth seeing.definitionKo: 보고 얻을 것이 많거나 볼 가치가 있다.
worth seeing.englishDescription: Having a lot of things to see and learn.

wrongdoer.englishDescription: A person who does another person harm.

yangban.englishDescription: (archaic) A member of the ruling class.
